turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: Honestly, I just feel kind of off lately—people say my comments aren’t fitting, and I’ve lost interest in family stuff. I also find myself craving chocolate pudding and potato chips, and I’ve put on about 10 kilograms; my affect feels sort of blunted.
How old are you, and roughly how long have you been experiencing these changes in your behavior and appetite?

“Doctor, I’m 55, and it’s been going on for about six months—people have been telling me my comments aren’t fitting, and I’ve mostly been uninterested in family, with those cravings and the weight gain since then.”
Have you or your family noticed any problems with your memory, or any difficulties with your physical movements like stiffness or weakness?

“Doctor, my family says I’ve seemed less engaged with them than before, but I don’t think my memory is notably worse. I haven’t noticed stiffness or weakness, and my movement feels pretty normal to me.”
Have you or your family noticed any new repetitive

“Doctor, I don’t know about repetitive behaviors—my main issue is that I’ve been making comments that seem out of place and I don’t feel much interest in my family. I haven’t had any stiffness or trouble moving, and I’m mainly just fixated on those cravings and feeling more withdrawn.”
Have you experienced any changes in your mood

“Doctor, my mood feels kind of flat or blunted lately—I don’t really feel much the way I used to, and I don’t get bothered much by it. I’ve mostly just become withdrawn and indifferent to interactions, rather than feeling clearly sad or overly happy.”

“Doctor, I haven’t had any head injuries that I can recall. I’m mostly just getting more withdrawn and indifferent, with those out-of-place comments and the cravings staying pretty consistent.”

“Doctor, they’ve also noticed I sometimes act in ways that don’t seem appropriate—like I’ll say things that don’t fit the situation, and occasionally I try to be physically friendly with strangers, which isn’t like me. They’ve called me unkempt lately too, and I just feel indifferent to most of it.”
